import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    st = np.sqrt(t)
    w = params[3]
    c = np.cos(w*st); s = np.sin(w*st)
    return (params[0] + params[1]/v + params[2]*np.sqrt(x)
            + (params[4] + params[5]*st)*c + (params[6] + params[7]*st)*s
            + params[8]*c/v + params[9]*s/v)
